mapper.select: select cr_file from cmr0025 a, cmr0021 b where a.cr_itemid = #{itemid} and a.cr_ver = b.cr_version and a.cr_itemid = b.cr_itemid and substr(a.cr_acptno,5,2) in ('07','16') and b.cr_aftviewver = #{lstver} and rownum=1
select b.cr_file from cmr0020 a, cmr0026 b where a.cr_itemid = #{id} and a.cr_itemid = b.cr_itemid and a.cr_tstver != 0 and a.cr_lstver = b.cr_basever and a.cr_tstver = b.cr_ver

select b.cr_file from cmr0020 a, cmr0025 b, cmr0021 c where a.cr_itemid = #{CR_ITEMID} and a.cr_itemid = b.cr_itemid and (c.cr_aftviewver = #{CR_VER} or to_char(c.cr_version) = #{CR_VER}) and b.cr_itemid = c.cr_itemid and b.cr_acptno = c.cr_acptno and b.cr_ver = c.cr_version and rownum = 1

select a.cr_rsrccd,a.cr_rsrcname,a.cr_jobcd,a.cr_lstver,a.cr_itemid, a.cr_syscd, b.cm_dirpath,e.CM_CODENAME as jawon,d.CM_INFO from cmm0070 b,cmr0020 a,cmm0036 d,cmm0020 e where a.cr_itemid = #{id} and a.cr_syscd=b.cm_syscd and a.cr_dsncd=b.cm_dsncd and a.cr_syscd=d.cm_syscd and a.cr_rsrccd=d.cm_rsrccd and e.cm_macode='JAWON' and e.cm_micode=a.cr_rsrccd

select a.cr_rsrccd,a.cr_rsrcname,a.cr_jobcd,a.cr_lstver,a.cr_itemid, a.cr_syscd, b.cm_dirpath,e.CM_CODENAME as jawon,d.CM_INFO from cmm0070 b,cmr0020 a,cmd0011 c,cmm0036 d,cmm0020 e where c.cd_itemid = #{id} and c.cd_prcitem=a.cr_itemid and a.cr_syscd=b.cm_syscd and a.cr_dsncd=b.cm_dsncd and a.cr_syscd=d.cm_syscd and a.cr_rsrccd=d.cm_rsrccd and e.cm_macode='JAWON' and e.cm_micode=a.cr_rsrccd
select * from cmr0020, cmm0036 where cr_syscd = cm_syscd and cr_rsrccd = cm_rsrccd and cr_itemid=#{id}

select a.cr_itemid from cmm0070 b, cmr0020 a where a.cr_syscd = #{syscd} and a.cr_rsrccd = #{rsrccd} and upper(a.cr_rsrcname) = upper(#{rsrcname})
and upper(b.cm_dirpath) = upper(#{dirpath})
and a.cr_syscd = b.cm_syscd and a.cr_dsncd = b.cm_dsncd
mapper.delete:
delete cmr0025 where cr_itemid = #{item}
and cr_ver = #{ver}

delete cmr0021 where cr_itemid = #{item}
and cr_ver = #{ver}
mapper.select: select to_number(nvl(max(cr_itemid),to_char(SYSDATE,'yyyymm')||'000000')) + 1 as max from cmr0020 where substr(cr_itemid,1,6)=to_char(SYSDATE,'yyyymm')

select a.cr_status,a.cr_editor,a.cr_nomodify,b.cm_codename,c.cm_info,d.cm_username, a.cr_isrid from cmr0020 a,cmm0020 b,cmm0036 c,cmm0040 d where a.cr_itemid = #{itemid} and b.cm_macode='CMR0020' and b.cm_micode=a.cr_status and a.cr_syscd=c.cm_syscd and a.cr_rsrccd=c.cm_rsrccd and a.cr_editor=d.cm_userid
and (substr(c.cm_info,12,1)='1' or substr(c.cm_info,2,1)='1')
